@name: City Guard
@slug: city_guard
@category: RMFRP Core
@default_cost: 40
@description:
 [Vocational] Almost every urban area has some sort of paid police force.
 These characters are in charge of making sure that the city remains free of
 bedlam in the streets. If a promotion is gained (in the Special section), the
 character has been promoted in the ranks (promotions equate to higher ranks).
 Time to Acquire: 25 months. Starting Money: normal plus d10.
